title: When the Static Breaks
author: Jude Thornbury
blurb: Bram Oyelaran, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
